_comment: winget catalog (IDs verified in the winget-pkgs repository). scope machine = winget runs elevated; scope user = per-user installer, started as the signed-in user (this is not winget --scope). detect = regex on installed program names (empty = cannot be detected reliably). installerType = winget --installer-type: Microsoft.DirectX uses exe, because its manifest also offers the packaged-app framework, which winget picks by default and which does not install the runtime of older games (dxwebsetup.exe does).
